content.bridge_context: Reviewing and mastering operations with Fractions.

units.title: Types of Fractions
units.explanation: Proper (numerator < denominator), Improper (numerator > denominator), Mixed (whole number + proper fraction).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify 7/4 as proper or improper. / 7/4 को उचित या अनुचित भिन्न के रूप में पहचानें।

units.title: Reciprocal of a Fraction
units.explanation: Inverting a fraction (flipping it). Reciprocal of a/b is b/a.
units.dual_language_instruction: What is the reciprocal of 2/3? / 2/3 का व्युत्क्रम (reciprocal) क्या है?
